about_the_game:
Imagine a timeline where the Roman Empire never fell, but instead advanced directly into the age of renewable energy and space exploration. This city-builder challenges you to act as the architect of this anachronistic metropolis. You will merge the classical aesthetics of marble columns and aqueducts with the efficiency of wind turbines, neon-lit boulevards, and automated drones.

Power a modern metropolis with wind farms, solar arrays, and nuclear plants rising beside ancient temples. Evolve the city by repurposing stone aqueducts into high-speed monorails, carving tram lines through marble boulevards, and replacing foot couriers with autonomous drone networks. At the height of imperial ambition, look beyond the city and the Earth itself. Unlock aerospace technology, build starships, train astronauts, and carry the Eagle to the Moon.

Development status

This project is a concept we are passionate about bringing to life. However, active development is currently paused. We are scheduled to resume full-scale production in Mid-2026. When we return, we will deploy a visual overhaul and expanded gameplay mechanics based on this foundation. If you want this game to exist, adding it to your Wishlist is the most powerful way to show support. It validates the concept and ensures you are the first to know when the Roman Space Age begins.

Wishlist today to be notified when development resumes in 2026.

short_description: A city builder that combines futurism and the aesthetics of ancient Rome. Lead your people into the future era by researching new technologies, creating modern infrastructure, and withstanding external forces. Make Rome an eternal city!
